title.es: El de la bendición de Jaime

description.es: Jaime le dice a Damián que debería estar orgulloso de Marta, que es una persona maravillosa, que no le dé la espalda y que quiera a quien quiera querer.
description.en: Jaime tells Damián that he should be proud of Marta, that she is a wonderful person, that he should not turn his back on her, and that she should be free to love whomever she wants.
